title: Compare text
summary: Perl: Compare text. Try the value dog. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: eq compares text. == is the numeric comparison operator. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Install Perl 5. Save one example as lesson.pl and run perl lesson.pl.

blocks.title: Compare text

blocks.text: eq compares the letters in two strings. Both are cat, so Yes is selected.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Using == for words can cause unwanted number conversion.
